about: How a public page describes itself, as the web agreed it (read by ./page-facts.mjs). Each list names the <meta property|name> keys that carry one fact, in order: the first key a page states wins for a single fact (title, description, site), and every key is read for a list (pictures, videos), deduplicated in the order found. icon_rels are <link rel> words that name the page's icon. structured_data reads the page's <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks (schema.org): at most max_blocks objects (each object of a block's @graph counts as one), at most max_characters of them in all, walked no deeper than max_depth; picture_keys and video_keys are the keys whose values (a web address, an { url } object, or a list of them) add to pictures and videos. direct_files says which list a link that is itself a file adds to, by the start of its media type. max_pictures and max_videos cap each list. A new convention is one more key here, never a change to the reader.
